notes.title: Bigger, Better Bang for Buck
notes.content:
[b]Stereo Aereo[/b] is back, and [b]fully improved[/b].

We’ve been working on a [b]big[/b] update for Stereo Aereo, and are happy to release it today, along the PS4 release of Stereo Aereo (The game is also available on XBOX one) :)

To celebrate this [b]epic milestone[/b] we’ve [b]lowered the price[/b] of Stereo Aereo [b]permanently[/b] from $6,99 to [b]$3,99[/b] and made the following improvements to the game:

[list][*] [b]Content:[/b] New levels, 9 and 10: Stereo Aereo will have to face their biggest musical challenge yet.
[*] [b]Gameplay:[/b] Patterns in all levels have been remastered, along with their songs.
[*] [b]Boss fights:[/b] Checkpoints have been added on boss battle stages.
[*] [b]Graphics:[/b] Cutscenes have gotten a mayor lift in animation and color.
[*] [b]Overall:[/b] Improved performance and graphics.[/list]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26684431/dedffec52fa83df516f18d7df79f9db103106429.png[/img]

We hope you’ll enjoy the newly improved Stereo Aereo!

Cheers,



The StoneBot Studio
